title: ClipBell — New Video Alerts, Privately
description: Never miss new videos on topics you follow. ClipBell brings tidy video alerts to Chrome, Edge and Brave. Free for 3 topics. No account.
text: For the things you love to follow # Never miss a new video on anything you follow. Movies. Cricket. That next big tech launch. ClipBell quietly finds new videos on your topics and keeps them in one tidy list. [Add to Chrome](https://clipbell.com/#install-info)[See how it works](https://clipbell.com/how-it-works/) Private by design. Everything stays on your computer. Free for 3 topics No sign-up Chrome · Edge · Brave A little corner of your browser Your next watch 3 A few new things, just for your topics. Movies Cricket Tech Podcasts 2:18 ### The next big adventure · Official trailer Movie trailer · Sample result Free to watch Region tag 24:10 ### Behind the scenes · Cast conversation Interview · Sample result Not sure Region tag 42:00 ### A new chapter · Full episode Show · Sample result Subscription · Platform name Region tag Quiet checks. Tidy results. On your computer One video. One card. Less clutter. Illustrative preview · sample topics and results A topic for every little interest Movies & trailers Cricket Tech launches Podcasts Music Education Less checking. More watching. ## How do new videos find their way to you? Add a topic. ClipBell searches the web once or twice a day. Open your list when you’re ready. 01 ### Tell your bell what to follow. Add a movie, an interview, a team, a podcast or any topic you care about. A few clear words are enough to start. 02 ### Let the new videos collect. ClipBell quietly checks once or twice a day. New results collect in your list, with a small count on the icon and no spam. 03 ### Come back. Tap. Watch. Open ClipBell whenever you like. Choose a result to watch on its original site, or save it for later. A calmer way to keep up ## A little bell. A lot less clutter. [Explore all features](https://clipbell.com/features/) ### One video. One clean card. Copies of the same video across many sites are grouped together. Spend less time scrolling past repeats. 1 grouped result ### More of what you came for. Use Pro filters for quality, length and dates. Block unwanted sites and leave out words like “reaction” or “shorts”. 1080p+ Trailer This week No reactions ### Your topics. Your kind of quiet. Start with a silent icon count. Pro adds popups and a daily digest. Set quiet hours and keep sound on or off. Silent Popup Daily digest Know before you open ## Free, subscription, or not sure? Every result is sorted into a viewing category, so you can see what to expect before following the link. Free to watch ### A good place to start. The result is identified as free to view. Open the link to watch on the original site. Subscription ### See the platform first. The result needs a subscription. ClipBell shows the streaming platform name, so you know where it opens. Not sure ### A little honesty helps. ClipBell cannot confidently tell whether it is free or subscription. Check the linked site for its current access requirements. A region tag shows whether a video opens in your region. Access and availability are set by the linked site. ClipBell Pro does not include a streaming subscription. Your interests are yours ## A private video tracker. Right where you are. Your topics, results and history stay in your browser on your computer. We never see, collect or sell them. [Read our privacy promise](https://clipbell.com/privacy/) ### No account. No tracking. No ads. No sign-up and no analytics on your topics. ### A little extra privacy when you want it. PIN lock, auto-lock and a quick-lock shortcut. Pro adds a master PIN for personal topics. ### Optional AI that stays on your device. On supported browsers, on-device AI improves matching without sending data to us. Follow your kind of interesting ## What will you follow? ClipBell brings topic-based video release alerts to everyday interests, from a film you’re waiting for to a story you’re following. ### Movie fans Trailers, cast interviews and a little behind the scenes. ### Sports fans Cricket highlights, team interviews and new coverage. ### Tech followers Product launches and the conversations around them. ### Podcast listeners New video episodes and conversations worth saving. ### Media & PR teams Keep topic-related video coverage in one tidy place. [Find your use case](https://clipbell.com/use-cases/) ### Start with a little. Follow a lot. Free for up to 3 topics. Pro adds unlimited topics and more control from ₹99 + GST / month in India or $2.99/month outside India, with yearly and founder lifetime options. [Compare Free & Pro](https://clipbell.com/pricing/) A few good questions ## Curious about your little bell? ClipBell is a video alert extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave. Here are a few things to know before you start. [Read all 30 answers](https://clipbell.com/faq/) ### What is ClipBell? ClipBell is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave that gives you new video alerts for topics you care about. Made in India by Tanishkha, it searches the web once or twice a day and collects new results in one list on your computer. ### Is ClipBell free? Yes. The Free plan includes up to 3 topics, the newest 20 videos per topic, silent alerts and one PIN. Pro adds unlimited topics, full history, more alert choices and additional features. ### Do I need an account? No. ClipBell needs no account and no sign-up. A Pro licence key is checked without sending any of your topics. ### Does ClipBell see my topics? No. Your topics, results and history stay in your browser on your computer. We never see, collect or sell them, and there is no tracking, analytics on your topics or advertising. ### Which browsers are supported? ClipBell supports Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer. Phone support is not available yet. ### How do refunds work? Your first Pro purchase is eligible for a full refund within 7 days. Lifetime purchases have a 14-day refund window. Later renewal periods are not refundable except where the law requires. Approved refunds are submitted to the original payment method within 5–7 business days; your bank or payment provider may take longer to credit them. See the Refund & Cancellation Policy for details. ## Your next favourite video. A little easier to find. Follow up to 3 topics for free. No account. No sign-up. [Add to Chrome](https://clipbell.com/#install-info) Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer.

title: ClipBell Features — Smart, Private Video Alerts
description: Explore ClipBell alerts, grouped video results, quality filters, folders, PIN locks and personalisation. Follow videos with less clutter.
text: - [Home](https://clipbell.com/) - Features Features, without the noise # Everything for a tidier next-watch list. ClipBell gives you new video alerts, grouped results and simple ways to filter, organise and protect your topics. You decide how much attention each topic needs. [Alerts](#alerts)[Smart results](#smart-results)[Filters](#filters)[Organise](#organise)[Privacy and lock](#privacy-lock)[Personalise](#personalise) Alerts ## How would you like to hear about new videos? Choose alerts per topic and keep your day calm. ClipBell checks once or twice daily; priority topics are checked twice a day. ### Silent by default New videos collect in your list with a small count on the icon. Silent alerts are included in Free. ### Popup or daily digestPRO Pro lets you choose popup alerts or a daily digest for each topic, alongside silent mode. ### Quiet hours and sound Set quiet hours and turn sound on or off to suit your day. ### Priority topics Priority topics are checked twice a day. Checks are scheduled, so alerts are not immediate. Smart results ## How does ClipBell keep results useful? ClipBell groups copies of the same video into one card. Viewing labels and a region tag help you decide which link to open. ### One video, one card Copies across many sites are grouped together, so your list does not repeat the same video as separate cards. ### Clear viewing labels Results are sorted into Free to watch, Subscription and Not sure. Subscription results show the streaming platform name. ### Region at a glance A region tag shows whether a video opens in your region. Availability still depends on the original site. ### Related videos, one tap awayPRO Open related videos from any result when you want to explore more of the topic. ### Optional on-device matching On browsers that support it, optional on-device AI improves matching without sending data to ClipBell. Filters ## How can you get closer to the videos you want? Pro includes all filters. Narrow results by quality, length and date, then give the sources you trust a better place in your list. ### Video qualityPRO Choose the quality you want, such as 1080p or higher. ### Video lengthPRO Use length filters such as trailer, episode or full movie. ### Date and custom rangesPRO Filter by date or set a custom date range, then choose your sort order. ### Your source preferencesPRO Block sites you do not want, exclude words such as “reaction” or “shorts”, and put trusted sources first. Organise ## How do you keep a list you can come back to? Use seen status, watch later, favourites, history and folders to keep useful videos easy to find. ### Mark as seen Keep track of the videos you have already watched. ### Watch later and favourites Save a result for when you have time, or add it to favourites for another visit. ### History Revisit results you have seen before using your locally stored history. ### Folders Bring related videos together in folders, whether you follow movies, sports or a few different interests. Privacy and lock ## How do your topics stay yours? Your topics, results and history are stored only in your browser on your computer. No account or sign-up is needed. ### PIN lock and auto-lock Free includes one PIN. ClipBell also offers auto-lock and a quick-lock keyboard shortcut. ### Master PIN and personal topicsPRO Pro adds a master PIN for personal topics you want to keep to yourself. ### No tracking or advertising We never see, collect or sell your topics, results or history. There are no ads and no analytics on your topics. ### A separate licence check Your Pro licence key is checked without sending any topics. Payment handling and support are explained in the Privacy Policy. Personalise ## How can ClipBell feel more like your browser? Choose the view that is easiest for you to scan. You can also personalise ClipBell’s toolbar icon and its name. ### Three ways to browse Switch between list, compact text and grid view. ### Thumbnails on or off Keep images visible or choose a quieter view without thumbnails. ### Your toolbar icon and name Personalise the icon and name shown in the toolbar. Explore the [Free and Pro comparison](https://clipbell.com/pricing/) to choose the plan that fits your topics. ## Your next favourite video. A little easier to find. Follow up to 3 topics for free. No account. No sign-up. [Add to Chrome](https://clipbell.com/#install-info) Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer.

title: How ClipBell Works — Set Up New Video Alerts
description: Add a topic, choose your alerts and let ClipBell find new videos once or twice daily. A simple setup guide for Chrome, Edge and Brave.
text: - [Home](https://clipbell.com/) - How it works A small setup. A simpler habit. # Add a topic. Let your bell take it from there. ClipBell quietly collects new videos about the things you follow. Set up a topic, choose your alerts, and come back when you are ready to watch. 01 ## Install ClipBell in your browser. Add ClipBell to Chrome, Edge or Brave on your computer. You do not need to create an account. - Use the official extension listing when the install link is available. - Open ClipBell from your browser toolbar. [Image: Screenshot placeholder: ClipBell installation and toolbar icon in a supported desktop browser.] Screenshot placeholder 1 of 4 · replace with the final extension screen. 02 ## Add a topic you care about. Start with a clear phrase, such as “new Tamil movie official trailer” or “India cricket highlights”. - Add the movie, team, show, launch or podcast you want to follow. - Free supports up to 3 topics. Pro supports unlimited topics. [Image: Screenshot placeholder: adding a clear movie-trailer topic to ClipBell.] Screenshot placeholder 2 of 4 · replace with the final extension screen. 03 ## Choose your kind of alert. Use a silent icon count, or choose popup or daily digest alerts with Pro. Quiet hours and the sound toggle help you control interruptions. - Choose the alert mode for each topic. - Set source preferences and use Pro filters when you want narrower results. [Image: Screenshot placeholder: per-topic silent, popup and daily digest alert choices with quiet hours.] Screenshot placeholder 3 of 4 · replace with the final extension screen. 04 ## Let ClipBell check, then pick a video. ClipBell searches the web once or twice a day. Priority topics are checked twice a day, and new videos collect in your list. - Open ClipBell whenever you like and review the viewing labels and region tag. - Tap a result to watch on its original site, or save it to watch later. [Image: Screenshot placeholder: grouped video cards with Free to watch, Subscription and Not sure labels.] Screenshot placeholder 4 of 4 · replace with the final extension screen. A few words go a long way ## What makes a good topic? A specific topic helps ClipBell match the videos you mean. Name the subject and the kind of video you want, then refine your list with filters. | Interest | Example topic | Make it clearer | | --- | --- | --- | | Movies | New Tamil movie official trailer | Add the title and release year when you know them. | | Interviews | New film cast interview | Include “interview” and the film or show. | | Cricket | India cricket highlights | Add a tournament or match date for a narrower topic. | | Tech | Wireless earbuds launch | Use the model or product category with “launch”. | | Podcasts | Science podcast new episode | Add the show name when you have a particular podcast in mind. | **Keep each topic focused.** Use separate topics for separate interests. Put trusted sources first, and exclude words such as “reaction” or “shorts” when those clips are not useful to you. **Give it time.** ClipBell checks on a daily schedule. If your browser is closed, it catches up when you reopen. It does not promise an alert the moment a video is released. ## Your next favourite video. A little easier to find. Follow up to 3 topics for free. No account. No sign-up. [Add to Chrome](https://clipbell.com/#install-info) Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer.

title: ClipBell Privacy Policy | Your Topics Stay Local
description: Learn how ClipBell keeps your topics, results and history on your computer, and how support, licence checks and payments are handled.
text: - [Home](https://clipbell.com/) - Privacy policy Clear information. No small surprises. # ClipBell Privacy Policy Private by design. Everything stays on your computer. ClipBell keeps your topics, results and history in your browser, with no account or sign-up. **Effective date: 18 October 2026.** Questions about this policy: [support@clipbell.com](mailto:support@clipbell.com). ## On this page - [Who is responsible for ClipBell?](#policy-1) - [What stays on your computer?](#policy-2) - [What can the extension access, and why?](#policy-3) - [What do other websites receive?](#policy-4) - [Does the optional AI send my topics to Tanishkha?](#policy-5) - [How do PIN locks protect my list?](#policy-6) - [What happens during a Pro licence check?](#policy-7) - [Who handles payment details?](#policy-8) - [What if I email you or use the contact form?](#policy-9) - [How long are records kept, and who can receive them?](#policy-10) - [What privacy choices and rights do I have?](#policy-11) - [Is ClipBell intended for children?](#policy-12) - [How will policy changes be shown?](#policy-13) ## Who is responsible for ClipBell? ClipBell is made by Tanishkha, a GST-registered business in India. Our business location is Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India. This policy explains the ClipBell extension and the separate support and payment choices described on clipbell.com and clipbell.app. For privacy questions, email support@clipbell.com. ## What stays on your computer? The ClipBell extension does not collect your personal data, topics, results or history. Your topics, results and history stay locally in your browser on your computer. Tanishkha never sees, collects or sells them. No account is needed. There is no tracking, no analytics on your topics and no ads. The separate Pro licence check, voluntary support contact and payment processing are explained below. ## What can the extension access, and why? ClipBell uses browser access to find publicly available videos, save your list locally and show the alerts you choose. - Web pages: ClipBell accesses publicly available pages it searches to find and match videos for your topics. - Browser storage: ClipBell stores your topics, results, history and preferences in your browser on your computer. - Notifications: ClipBell uses notification access for your chosen alerts. You can choose silent alerts, or Pro popup and daily digest alerts, with quiet hours and a sound toggle. ## What do other websites receive? ClipBell searches publicly available web pages directly from your browser, the same way you would. Those websites receive the web requests needed to provide their pages and apply their own privacy practices. When you open a video, the website you visit handles your visit under its own terms and privacy policy. ClipBell only links to videos; it does not host or control them. ## Does the optional AI send my topics to Tanishkha? No. Optional on-device AI improves matching without sending data to Tanishkha, when your browser supports it. This feature works on your device. It is optional and depends on browser support. ## How do PIN locks protect my list? ClipBell offers a PIN lock with auto-lock and a quick-lock keyboard shortcut. Pro also includes a master PIN for personal topics you want to keep to yourself. Keep your computer and browser protected as well. A PIN controls access within ClipBell; it does not promise protection against every form of access to your device. ## What happens during a Pro licence check? A Pro licence key is checked to confirm paid access without sending any of your topics. The licence check is separate from your locally stored topics, results and history. ## Who handles payment details? Pro payments are handled by Razorpay through its checkout. You provide payment details to the payment provider. Tanishkha does not collect or store your full card details or UPI PIN. The provider handles payment information under its own privacy policy. A transaction reference, payment status or receipt may be needed to provide Pro access, deal with a refund or meet applicable accounting duties. These purchase records are separate from your private topic list. ## What if I email you or use the contact form? If you contact us, you choose to share your email address, message and any name you provide. We use those details to respond to your request and resolve the issue you raise. You do not need to send your topics, history, PIN or full payment details for a general support question. Support correspondence is separate from information saved inside the extension. ## How long are records kept, and who can receive them? Your extension data stays in local browser storage under your control. Tanishkha does not hold a central copy of your topics, results or history. We keep support messages while dealing with your request and for any period needed to resolve a related dispute or meet a legal duty. Purchase records follow applicable accounting and record-keeping requirements. For details about service providers, website requests, retention periods or international transfers, email support@clipbell.com. Where the GDPR applies, handling a service or purchase request relies on taking steps at your request or fulfilling a contract. Records required by law rely on a legal obligation. If an activity needs your consent, we ask for it and you can withdraw it. ## What privacy choices and rights do I have? You control the information stored in your browser. For information you voluntarily share with Tanishkha, you can contact support@clipbell.com with a privacy request. Depending on the law that applies, your rights may include access, a copy, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability or withdrawal of consent. You may also have a right to complain to the relevant data protection authority and, in India where applicable, to nominate someone to exercise your rights. We will handle requests under the applicable provisions of India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the GDPR where it applies, and other relevant law. We cannot retrieve a local topic list or history that we do not hold. ## Is ClipBell intended for children? ClipBell is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect children's personal data through the extension's video-tracking features. This age statement does not replace higher age thresholds or parental-consent requirements under applicable law. A parent or guardian who believes a child has shared personal information with support can contact support@clipbell.com. ## How will policy changes be shown? The current policy will be available on this page with its effective date. Any material change to the handling described here will be explained in an updated notice. For a privacy question or concern, contact Tanishkha at support@clipbell.com, Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India.

title: ClipBell Refund & Cancellation Policy
description: Cancel ClipBell Pro any time. Read the 7-day first-purchase and 14-day lifetime refund windows, renewal rules and refund process.
text: - [Home](https://clipbell.com/) - Refunds & cancellation Clear information. No small surprises. # Refund & Cancellation Policy You can cancel Pro at any time. A first Pro subscription purchase has a 7-day full refund window, and a lifetime purchase has a 14-day full refund window. **Effective date: 18 October 2026.** Questions about this policy: [support@clipbell.com](mailto:support@clipbell.com). ## On this page - [How do I cancel Pro?](#policy-1) - [Can I get a refund on my first Pro purchase?](#policy-2) - [Are renewal payments refundable?](#policy-3) - [What is the lifetime refund window?](#policy-4) - [How do I request a refund?](#policy-5) - [Where does the refund go, and how long does it take?](#policy-6) - [Who processes the payment and refund?](#policy-7) - [Does this policy limit my consumer rights?](#policy-8) - [How can I contact you about a payment?](#policy-9) ## How do I cancel Pro? Cancel your monthly or yearly Pro subscription at any time by emailing support@clipbell.com. Cancellation stops future renewals once it takes effect. The effective date and any remaining paid access follow the terms shown for your plan. Use the cancellation process to stop renewals; do not rely on removing the extension. Cancelling a subscription does not automatically request a refund. If you are eligible for a refund, ask for one using the steps below. ## Can I get a refund on my first Pro purchase? Yes. You can request a full refund within 7 calendar days of your first monthly or yearly Pro purchase. Send your request within that window to support@clipbell.com. The date you submit the request determines whether it is within the refund window. ## Are renewal payments refundable? Later renewal periods are not refundable, except where applicable law requires a refund or another remedy. To avoid another renewal payment, complete the cancellation process before the next renewal. If you believe a charge was made in error, contact support@clipbell.com so it can be reviewed. ## What is the lifetime refund window? A lifetime Pro purchase is eligible for a full refund when you request it within 14 calendar days of purchase. A lifetime purchase has no recurring renewal to cancel. After the refund window, refunds are available where applicable law requires them. ## How do I request a refund? Email support@clipbell.com with enough information to locate your purchase. You do not need to share your topics, viewing history or PIN. - State that you are requesting a refund. - Include your payment or order reference, if available. - Include the purchase date and the email used for the payment, if one was provided. - Do not include full card details or your UPI PIN. ## Where does the refund go, and how long does it take? Approved refunds are submitted to the original payment method within 5–7 business days. Your bank or payment provider may take longer to credit them. The payment provider and your bank control when the credit appears. That can take longer than our processing period and varies by payment method. Any shorter deadline required by applicable law will apply. If the refund has not appeared after the expected bank or provider timeframe, email support@clipbell.com with your transaction reference. ## Who processes the payment and refund? Payments and refunds are processed through Razorpay. Contact Tanishkha for ClipBell cancellation and refund requests. The payment provider handles the payment movement; ClipBell's purchase terms and your legal rights determine refund eligibility. ## Does this policy limit my consumer rights? No. This policy is in addition to rights that applicable law gives you. Mandatory cancellation, refund or other consumer remedies continue to apply. ## How can I contact you about a payment? Email support@clipbell.com. We aim to respond within 2 business days. The business providing ClipBell is Tanishkha, GST registered, Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India.

title: ClipBell FAQ — Video Alerts, Privacy, PINs and Pro
description: Get clear answers about ClipBell video alerts, supported browsers, private topics, PINs, pricing, cancellation and refunds.
text: - [Home](https://clipbell.com/) - FAQs The ClipBell FAQ # Good questions. Straight answers. ClipBell is a private video alert extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave. Find answers about topics, scheduled checks, privacy, PINs and Pro. Search questions and answers 30 answers ## What would you like to know about ClipBell? No matching questions yet. Try another word, or [contact us](https://clipbell.com/contact/). ### What is ClipBell? ClipBell is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave that gives you new video alerts for topics you care about. Made in India by Tanishkha, it searches the web once or twice a day and collects new results in one list on your computer. ### Is ClipBell free? Yes. The Free plan includes up to 3 topics, the newest 20 videos per topic, silent alerts and one PIN. Pro adds unlimited topics, full history, more alert choices and additional features. ### What does ClipBell Pro include? Pro includes unlimited topics, a master PIN for personal topics, popup and daily digest alerts, all filters and related videos. Pro is ₹99 + GST / month in India or $2.99/month outside India. Yearly Pro is ₹990 + GST or $29.90 (2 months free), and the one-time Founder lifetime plan is ₹2,999 + GST or $69, limited to the first 1,000 users. Indian buyers pay 18% GST on top. No GST outside India. ### Do I need an account? No. ClipBell needs no account and no sign-up. A Pro licence key is checked without sending any of your topics. ### Does ClipBell see my topics? No. Your topics, results and history stay in your browser on your computer. We never see, collect or sell them, and there is no tracking, analytics on your topics or advertising. ### How often does ClipBell check for new videos? ClipBell searches the web once or twice a day. Priority topics are checked twice a day. ### Why didn't I get an alert straight away? ClipBell checks on a daily schedule, so a newly released video may appear at the next check. Your alert mode and quiet hours also affect how you hear about it, and ClipBell catches up when you reopen a closed browser. ### What does “Not sure” mean? “Not sure” means ClipBell cannot confidently label a result as free to watch or subscription. Open the linked site to check its current viewing requirements. ### How are duplicate videos handled? Copies of the same video across different sites are grouped into one card. This keeps your list easier to scan without repeating the same video as separate results. ### Can I filter by video quality or length? Yes. Pro includes filters for video quality, such as 1080p or higher, and length, such as trailer, episode or full movie. You can also filter by date or a custom date range and choose the sort order. ### Does ClipBell download videos? No. ClipBell only links to videos on third-party sites. It does not host, download or copy the videos. ### Which browsers are supported? ClipBell supports Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer. Phone support is not available yet. ### Does ClipBell work when the browser is closed? ClipBell catches up when you reopen your browser. You should not expect checks or alerts while the browser is closed. ### What is the master PIN? The master PIN is a Pro feature for personal topics you want to keep to yourself. ClipBell also offers PIN locking, auto-lock and a quick-lock keyboard shortcut. ### I forgot my PIN. What should I do? Email support@clipbell.com for guidance for your installed version before resetting ClipBell or clearing browser storage. Your topics, results and history are stored only in that browser; support does not have a remote copy. ### How do I cancel Pro? You can cancel any time by emailing support@clipbell.com. The Refund & Cancellation Policy explains cancellation and refund terms. ### How do refunds work? Your first Pro purchase is eligible for a full refund within 7 days. Lifetime purchases have a 14-day refund window. Later renewal periods are not refundable except where the law requires. Approved refunds are submitted to the original payment method within 5–7 business days; your bank or payment provider may take longer to credit them. See the Refund & Cancellation Policy for details. ### Does ClipBell work in my country? ClipBell shows a region tag to help you see whether a video opens in your region. Availability depends on the linked site and the video, so a result may not be available in every country. ### Can I use ClipBell on my phone? Not yet. ClipBell is a browser extension for Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer. ### Is my ClipBell data backed up? Your ClipBell data is stored locally in your browser, and ClipBell does not provide a remote backup service. Clearing browser storage can remove local data, so contact support before clearing it if you need help. ### How do I contact support? Email support@clipbell.com or use the Contact page form to prepare an email in your email app. We aim to respond within 2 business days. ClipBell is made by Tanishkha in Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, India. ### What topics can I follow? You can follow topics such as movies, trailers, celebrity interviews, cricket and other sports, tech launches, podcasts, shows, news, music and education. A clear topic helps ClipBell find videos that match your interests. ### What do “Free to watch” and “Subscription” mean? “Free to watch” labels results identified as free to view. “Subscription” labels results that require a subscription and shows the streaming platform name. The linked site sets its own current access requirements. ### Does ClipBell Pro include streaming subscriptions? No. ClipBell Pro pays for the extension's Pro features. A video marked “Subscription” opens on a separate platform, where that platform's own access requirements apply. ### Can I choose how each topic alerts me? Yes. Free includes silent alerts, with a small count on the ClipBell icon when new videos collect in your list. Pro adds popup and daily digest alerts. ClipBell also has quiet hours and a sound toggle. ### Can I block sites or leave out unwanted videos? Yes. ClipBell lets you block sites, exclude words such as “reaction” or “shorts”, and put trusted sources first. Pro includes all filters. ### How can I organise the videos I find? You can mark videos as seen, save them to watch later, add favourites and organise them in folders. History helps you revisit previous results, and Pro includes one-tap access to related videos. ### Can I change how ClipBell looks? Yes. Choose list, compact text or grid view, with thumbnails on or off. You can also personalise the toolbar icon and its name. ### Does ClipBell’s optional AI send my topics to ClipBell? No. Optional on-device AI improves matching on your computer without sending data to ClipBell. This option is available only when your browser supports it. ### Can ClipBell be an alternative to YouTube video notifications? ClipBell offers another way to follow videos: topic-based alerts for publicly available videos across the web. It gives you one place to check for a movie, team or tech launch, but it does not guarantee coverage of every video on any platform. Need help with your own setup? Email [support@clipbell.com](mailto:support@clipbell.com). There is no need to send your topics or PIN. ## Your next favourite video. A little easier to find. Follow up to 3 topics for free. No account. No sign-up. [Add to Chrome](https://clipbell.com/#install-info) Chrome, Edge and Brave on your computer.
